name: TC-128: the date-range picker opens with quick-select presets
description: Clicking the date-range button opens the picker popover exposing the Quick Select presets (Last 7 days / Last 30 days), so owners can change the reporting window.
descriptionHtml: Clicking the date-range button opens the picker popover exposing the Quick Select presets (Last 7 days / Last 30 days), so owners can change the reporting window.

testStage.description: Clicking the date-range button opens the picker popover exposing the Quick Select presets (Last 7 days / Last 30 days), so owners can change the reporting window.

steps.name: Wait for selector getByRole('heading', { name: 'Restaurant Analytics' })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: /^(Today|Yesterday|Last 7 days|Last 30 days|Last 90 days|This month|Last month|This year|Last year)$|\d{1,2},\s*\d{4}\s*-\s*/ })
Click getByRole('button', { name: /^(Today|Yesterday|Last 7 days|Last 30 days|Last 90 days|This month|Last month|This year|Last year)$|\d{1,2},\s*\d{4}\s*-\s*/ })
Verify the quick-select presets are visible
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Last 7 days', exact: true })
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('button', { name: 'Last 30 days', exact: true })
